## Control

Produce, control, and distribute symmetric cryptographic keys using [Selection: NIST FIPS-validated; NSA-approved] key management technology and processes.

## Discussion

[SP 800-56A](https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.SP.800-56Ar3), [SP 800-56B](https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.SP.800-56Br2) , and [SP 800-56C](https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.SP.800-56Cr2) provide guidance on cryptographic key establishment schemes and key derivation methods. [SP 800-57-1](https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.SP.800-57pt1r5), [SP 800-57-2](https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.SP.800-57pt2r1) , and [SP 800-57-3](https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.SP.800-57pt3r1) provide guidance on cryptographic key management.
